xmldoc.short_description: Set a property value of an handle object.

param_input_item.param_description: a struct: field names are property names, field values are property values.
a cell array of N property names (character vectors or string scalars).
a 1-by-N cell array of values for every object, or an M-by-N cell array with row k for the k-th of M graphics objects.

param_output_item.param_description: user-settable properties and possible values for the object identified by h.

description.p: This routine can be used to modify the value of a specified property from an handle object.
For graphics objects, set(h, s) sets each field of the struct s as a property. With a struct array, each element is applied in turn.
set(h, names, values) sets the properties listed in the cell array names to the matching values.
Properties are applied in the given order: Position given before Units is converted to the new units.
Struct, cell and name/value forms can be combined in one call.

history_item.history_description: set(h, s) and set(h, names, values) for graphics objects.
